settings.privacyBody: Nou gard to nom, to grade, to bann matier, to progre ek to bann chat pou aplikasion kapav ed ou. Ou kapav efas to bann chat nimport ki ler.

privacy.title: Avi konfidansialite
privacy.intro: myKPT servi par bann elev ki ena mwins ki 18 an, alor nou ramas le mwins posib.
privacy.collect1: To email, pou ou kapav konekte.
privacy.collect2: Enn prenon ouswa tinom, to grade ek to bann matier.
privacy.collect3: To progre, not, flashcard ek chat avek tuter.
privacy.not1: Pa ni dat nesans, ni nimero telefonn, ni adres, ni nom lekol.
privacy.not2: Pa ena traker piblisite. Nou pa zame vann done.
privacy.ai1: To bann mesaz avoy kot nou founiser IA pou ekrir enn repons. Zot pa servi pou antrenn model IA.
privacy.ai2: Bann mesaz verifye pou to sekirite. Si kiksoz paret danzere, tuter montre ou kot enn dimounn ki kapav ed ou.
privacy.control1: Efas nimport ki chat depi listorik. Dimann enn paran, gardien ouswa profeser kontakte nou pou efas to kont.
